steps.text: ...We should stuff him into a sack...
...and hang him on the mast at dawn...
...We should slit his throat...
...and offer him to the ocean as a tribute to the raging hurricane...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...that same dream again.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Who is it?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...Oh, it's just you. Hm, I can't even seem to remember your name.
That doesn't matter. Just treat me like any normal Rhodes Island operator.
You look like you're in pain.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It's just another nightmare.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Dark fragments swirling in my consciousness, hidden beneath the shadows of that broken church...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: When I approach them, they turn into shackles and drag me down into the deep sea.
But soon, there will be a way to escape your torment.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Heh, is that so? That'd be great. But why should I trust you?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Your aura... I'm quite familiar with it.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: No, it's your smell. It's an intense, pungent smell... the smell of blood... 'their' smell. The smell of the deep sea.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It's a familiar and abhorrent smell.
Is that so?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Can you tell me your name?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Skadi.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Interesting. So, why did you decide to show up here?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You're not supposed to be here without permission from Kal'tsit, unless you're not afraid of me ripping you to pieces.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I am afraid. Just like everyone else. However, I'm used to fear.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It's time to go. By the time I come back, things may have already moved forward. However, you can forget all about me, just like before.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: To where the secret is buried.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: A place far, far away from you.
